decision_basis: Two independent Docker canonical-build cycles produced the same zte_tpd.ko SHA-256.
Candidate and stock AArch64 assembly have identical 140 instructions, 560-byte symbol size and resolved relocations; the prior 468-byte Ghidra metadata is recorded as stale source evidence.
Candidate and stock KCFI type IDs are identical: 0xc3d43b4d.
Strict Joern gate passed with zero parse problems and one-to-one source/Ghidra identity coverage using the recorded compatibility defines.
The dedicated ASAN/UBSAN contract passed 5/5 cases in both reproducible cycles, covering parse failure, mutex/cleanup, allocation, zeroing, callback and ENOMEM behavior.
review_findings: Joern retains three high-severity lifetime findings.
Joern retains two high-severity synchronization findings.
